**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mr Moor](../persons.html#1046)
I think it will be much better to throw the prizes open to the whole schools [sic]; it is so discouraging and troublesome to be put out of the competition, and everyone has not a garden who has children at school
My [mother](../persons.html#1606) says she meant her prizes instead of the home prize - of course they would chiefly concern the first - not the second - if all the extraparochial people are necessarily in the 3d class, she would extend it to them.
I suppose it will not wait till we see you

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

Envelope addressed to “The Revd/ J F Moor/Ampfield/Romsey.

Postmarked Winchester J 24/64.
